<div class="card-body">
'''Cal Alder''' is a [[Light]] [[Character]] ([[Rebel]]) from [[Hoth (Japanese)|Hoth (Japanese)]].
<nowiki />
<h2>Title</h2>
<span lang="ja">＊キャル・アルダー</span>
<h2>Card Text</h2>
<span lang="ja">防衛線では戦闘力＋１。自分のビークルは、キャルと同じ位置に移動するのならフォースを消費せずに移動できる。</span><ref name="jp-face">[[:File:Japanese-Hoth-Cal-Alder-PSA-151452830.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]].</ref>
<h2>Lore</h2>
''<span lang="ja">キャソル・セクターのカルシェボル出身。熟練した偵察兵。ブレン・ダーリンとは数年来の仲。エコー基地の外部防衛線をパトロールする。</span>''<ref name="jp-face" />
<h2>Translation of Japanese Text</h2>
'''Title:''' Cal Alder.

'''Card text:'''
Power +1 at a defensive perimeter. Your vehicles may move without spending Force if they move to the same location as Cal.

'''Lore:'''
From Kai'Shebbol in the Kathol sector. A skilled scout. He has served with Bren Derlin for years. He patrols the outer defensive line of Echo Base.

'''Comparison with the English printing:''' The Japanese moves vehicles for free when they move to Cal's location; the English when they move toward the same site as Cal.
<h2>Notes</h2>
Japanese-language printing of [[Cal Alder]] in [[Hoth (Japanese)]].<ref name="encyc">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 43, 103. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive].</ref><ref name="jp-face" />
